what_differs: WAGR-20 (Ready, unassigned) plans a Jumpr-side transform of one Agency-side rates/links file into Deals and waits for that file. The meetings decided that WagerTech does the transformation into Jumpr sheets (6/17), that deals load through a deal mapping/import sheet built with Joyce (7/24, 8/11), and that the clean production import includes Source (9/1). WAGR-477 now adds Player, Sign Up and Referral templates.
suggested_action: Rewrite WAGR-20 as the production migration plan for all go-live objects (operators, partners, deals with Source, DRAs if in scope, players, sign-ups, referrals). Use the template approach and load order, remove the dependency on the rates/links file or confirm it is still needed, and assign an owner.
